concerns.text: Success criterion SC-005 (compute feasibility) lacks any verification task. No task checks that the CI runtime stays < 6 h or that peak RAM stays under the 7 GB (or 2 GB) limit, making the criterion untestable.

Task T002 (generate_data.py) does not mention fixing random seeds. Constitution Principle I requires reproducibility via pinned seeds; without explicit seeding the synthetic dataset may not be reproducible.

Task T004 claims the CSV header includes all columns required by `experiment_log.schema.yaml`, but the schema defines an `edge_case` column. The verification step only checks header order, not presence of `edge_case`. Clarify that the header contains the `edge_case` field.
